title: U.S. House · Massachusetts's 4th District
area: Southeastern Massachusetts, including Newton, Taunton, and Fall River

context.text: Incumbent Jake Auchincloss defeated Jason Poulos in the September 1, 2026 Democratic primary. Thomas Stalcup is the Republican nominee.

summary.text: Auchincloss is the incumbent, serving since 2021. A Marine Corps veteran and former Newton city councilor, he sits on the House Energy and Commerce Committee.

background.text: Born in Boston, Massachusetts, in 1988; earned a bachelor's degree in government and economics from Harvard College (2010) and an M.B.A. from MIT (2016).
Served in the U.S. Marine Corps from 2010 to 2015, reaching the rank of captain.
Served on the Newton, Massachusetts City Council from 2016 to 2020 before his election to Congress.

priorities.text: Says gun safety is a priority as a former Marine officer who trained and deployed with assault weapons, calling for an assault-weapons ban and a suite of Massachusetts-style gun-safety measures.
Says the U.S. must meet its commitments under the Paris Climate Accords and supports clean-energy technologies including fusion, fission, geothermal, solar and offshore wind.

positions.summary: Calls for an assault-weapons ban and adopting Massachusetts-style gun-safety measures including background checks, safe storage, and red-flag laws.
positions.quote: As a former Marine officer who trained and deployed with assault weapons, gun safety is a priority for me. We need an assault-weapons ban, because weapons of war have no place on our streets or near our schools. And we need to adopt the common-sense suite of Massachusetts measures to reduce gun violence: background checks, safe storage, red-flag laws, and more.

positions.summary: Says he voted to codify abortion rights in his first term and earned a perfect rating from Planned Parenthood.
positions.quote: In my first term, I voted to codify abortion rights and earned a perfect rating from Planned Parenthood on their legislative scorecard. I will always use my voice and vote in Washington to protect women's healthcare.

positions.summary: Says the U.S. must meet its commitments under the Paris Climate Accords and supports building on the 117th Congress's clean-energy investments, including offshore wind development.
positions.quote: Building on the historic investments in clean energy & climate action of the 117th Congress, the United States must meet its commitments under the Paris Climate Accords. We must achieve a future of clean air, clean water, and clean energy that is too cheap to meter.

record.text: Serves on the House Committee on Energy and Commerce (Health, Energy, and Environment subcommittees) for 2025-2026.
Visited UMass Chan Medical School to discuss federal research-funding cuts and point-of-care clinical technology.
Earned a 100% rating on the End Citizens United/Let America Vote Scorecard.

summary.text: Stalcup is a Ph.D. physicist, entrepreneur, and self-described former Bernie Sanders supporter running as the Republican nominee. He founded an environmental-monitoring company and campaigns on a "Science Over Politics" platform.

background.text: Holds a Ph.D. in physics; founded an environmental-monitoring company whose systems have been deployed from the Arctic to Antarctica.

priorities.text: "I would require major federal policies to disclose the evidence, assumptions, and data supporting them; strengthen protections for scientific whistleblowers; require independent review of high-impact agency findings."
"I would vote to raise the federal minimum wage quickly to approximately $15 per hour and then index it to inflation."
"I would pursue a hybrid healthcare system that guarantees Medicare coverage for every American while allowing private insurers to compete across state lines under strong consumer protections."

positions.summary: Says he would vote to raise the federal minimum wage to about $15 per hour and index it to inflation.
positions.quote: I would vote to raise the federal minimum wage quickly to approximately $15 per hour and then index it to inflation so workers do not lose purchasing power.

positions.summary: Proposes a hybrid system guaranteeing Medicare coverage for every American while keeping private insurers competing across state lines.
positions.quote: I would pursue a hybrid healthcare system that guarantees Medicare coverage for every American while allowing private insurers to compete across state lines under strong consumer protections.

positions.summary: Would require body cameras and standardized training for ICE operations and protect long-settled undocumented workers from deportation, while creating a time-limited departure process for recent arrivals without viable asylum claims.

researchNotes: Rep. Auchincloss's key floor votes and FEC finance totals are added separately by script.
